summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing the completion of a USD 750 million senior unsecured fixed-rate notes issuance under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme. The notes are rated BBB by S&P and Baa3 by Moody's and will be listed on India International Exchange IFSC, NSE IFSC and SGX-ST. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no equity special-situation elements. It involves ordinary debt issuance, not a strategic event. The filing confirms the closing of notes offered outside the U.S., with no operational or corporate-control implications for the registrant. No special-situation characterization applies; the notes are standard corporate borrowings under an established programme.
